learning_objective: 🎯 Combine the joy of music, dancing, and acting with art by creating awesome masks, props, and rhythmic patterns!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: When we act or play, we can pretend to be anyone! We can use cardboard, colors, and string to build wonderful masks of animals, clowns, or kings.
A prop is a special object used in a play, like a magic wand or a shiny paper crown. Artists love designing and building these fun objects for the stage!
Just like a drum goes tap-tap-tap, art has rhythm too! When we repeat colors and shapes in a beautiful pattern, it feels like our drawing is dancing.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 The Dancing Paper Plate Mask!
fun_activity.instructions: Take a clean paper plate and carefully cut out two holes for eyes. Use markers, wool, and colorful paper scraps to decorate it like a joyful lion or a silly clown!

quick_recap: ⭐ Art is not just for looking at; it helps us act, sing, and perform!
⭐ We can create our own masks and props using simple craft materials.
⭐ Repeating shapes and lines gives our artwork a musical, dancing rhythm.
